cohort: 2440 mothers of healthy, term, and normal birthweight newborns
finding: The prescription and prolonged use of privately purchased pasteurized donor milk was associated with non-medical factors, such as cesarean birth, male newborn sex, and higher socioeconomic status.
mod_finding: Cesarean birth was associated with a higher prevalence of PDM use (OR: 2.05; 95% CI: 1.66, 2.55) and prolonged PDM use (OR: 2.09; 95% CI: 1.02, 4.28).
